name: io.github.slizer138/sitemap-url-extractor
title: Sitemap URL Extractor (via Apify)
description: Every URL from a site's sitemap.xml with lastmod, plus new/removed page diffs. $0.20 per 1,000 URLs.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional 'Bearer <your Apify token>' if your client cannot do OAuth. Runs bill per event to your Apify account.
